stories.title: Serbia votes in election with turnout highest in decades
stories.summary: Serbians turned out in the highest numbers in decades for a parliamentary election that pits President Aleksandar Vucic's governing party against a student-led movement challenging his 12-year rule. The result is a test of whether months of street protests can convert into electoral power.

stories.title: Death toll in Nigeria village raid rises to 48, police say
stories.summary: Gunmen raided a village in north-east Nigeria, looting shops and killing residents, and police said the death toll has climbed to 48. Security forces reached the area after the attackers had fled and are patrolling to restore calm.

stories.title: Brazil votes in Lula-Bolsonaro presidential election
stories.summary: Brazilians are voting in a presidential election between left-wing incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing challenger Jair Bolsonaro, with trade, security and the health of democratic institutions on the ballot. The outcome will shape Brazil's economic direction and its relations with the US and China.

stories.title: Maria Corina Machado returns to Venezuela after months in exile
stories.summary: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado returned home after months abroad, a move that could reset the opposition's strategy. Her reappearance tests whether the government will tolerate a leading critic operating openly inside the country.

stories.title: AI delivers 'zero financial payoff' to most companies, Apollo economist says
stories.summary: An Apollo Global Management economist argues that AI has produced essentially no measurable financial return at most companies so far, even as spending on chips, data centers and models surges. The claim feeds an intensifying investor debate over whether AI capital spending can ever earn its keep.

stories.title: Instagram Reels arrive on Apple TV
stories.summary: Instagram now lets users watch Reels on Apple TV, extending short-form video from phones to the living room. It is the latest step in Meta's effort to push Reels onto bigger screens and compete for streaming-time attention.

stories.title: r/opensource bans AI content and non-English posts in rules overhaul
stories.summary: Moderators of Reddit's r/opensource subreddit banned AI-generated content and posts from non-English speakers as part of a broader rules change. The move reflects mounting friction in open-source communities over AI slop and moderation workload.

stories.title: Google's AI search changes upended online publishing
stories.summary: A Verge column examines how Google's AI-driven search results have reshaped traffic for online publishers, as AI answers satisfy queries that once produced clicks. Publishers are rethinking referral strategies as a result.

stories.title: Browns CB Myles Harden questionable to return with hamstring injury
stories.summary: Cleveland cornerback Myles Harden left Sunday's game at Tennessee with a hamstring injury and was listed as questionable to return. His status matters for a secondary already absorbing injuries.

stories.title: Browns RT Tytus Howard being evaluated for a concussion
stories.summary: Cleveland right tackle Tytus Howard was ruled questionable to return against the Titans while being evaluated for a concussion. Losing him for any stretch would force another reshuffle on the offensive line.

stories.title: Browns lead Titans 17-14 entering the fourth quarter
stories.summary: Cleveland took a 17-14 lead over Tennessee into the fourth quarter of their Week 7 game in Nashville. The Browns are trying to protect the top spot in the AFC North.

stories.title: Denzel Ward active for Titans game despite hand injury
stories.summary: Cornerback Denzel Ward was active against Tennessee after injuring his hand in Friday's practice, and linebacker Quincy Williams also played. Both were key availability wins for a Cleveland defense missing other starters.

stories.title: Ohio State jumps to No. 2 in AP Top 25 after bye week
stories.summary: Ohio State climbed to No. 2 in the latest AP Top 25 without playing, benefiting from a weekend when five top-seven teams lost. The Buckeyes visit USC next weekend.

stories.title: Ohio State holds No. 2 in Coaches Poll, will face USC without Julian Sayin
stories.summary: The Buckeyes stayed at No. 2 in the Week 8 Coaches Poll while Miami kept the top spot and BYU tumbled to No. 9 after losing to UCF. Ohio State heads to No. 25 USC on Saturday at 7:30 p.m. without injured quarterback Julian Sayin.

stories.title: Ranking Ohio State's remaining games from easiest to hardest
stories.summary: Land-Grant Holy Land ranked the Buckeyes' remaining regular-season opponents by difficulty as the stretch run begins with a trip to USC on Oct. 31. The exercise highlights how little margin Ohio State has left against ranked Big Ten competition.

stories.title: With Sayin out, Ryan Day urged to open up the offense
stories.summary: With quarterback Julian Sayin expected to miss time with a shoulder and elbow injury, Land-Grant Holy Land argues Ryan Day should loosen the offense for his replacement rather than lean on a conservative plan. Sayin was hurt in the fourth quarter of the 19-15 win at Indiana.

stories.title: Gademan wins F1 Academy feature race after Palmowski-Larsen crash
stories.summary: Gademan took a maiden F1 Academy feature race victory in Austin after a crash involving title contenders Alisha Palmowski and Larsen shook up the race. The incident reshaped the weekend's championship picture.

stories.title: Toto Wolff says he is vetting 'two or three people' to replace him at Mercedes
stories.summary: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff revealed he is actively assessing a small shortlist of candidates to eventually succeed him. The admission signals formal succession planning at the team he has led since 2013.

stories.title: COTA plans a second track alongside Turn 1 clubhouse build
stories.summary: Circuit of the Americas is developing a clubhouse at Turn 1 and has plans to add a second track on the site, according to Autosport. The expansion would give the Austin venue more year-round business beyond US Grand Prix weekend.

stories.title: Verstappen tells COTA boss to try his car over track bumps
stories.summary: Max Verstappen pushed back at Circuit of the Americas leadership over criticism of drivers complaining about the track's bumps, saying the executive could drive his car and 'after five laps he won't be able to walk.' The exchange underlines driver frustration with Austin's surface.

stories.title: Crawford County man arrested over child sexual abuse material
stories.summary: A Crawford County man was arrested in connection with child sexual abuse material crimes, 10TV reported Sunday. Charges and a court date were not immediately detailed in the initial report.

stories.title: High-profile abuse case tests Ohio's new anti-grooming law
stories.summary: A high-profile sexual abuse case is giving Ohio courts an early test of the state's new anti-grooming statute, which targets the manipulative behavior used to prepare children for abuse. How prosecutors apply it could set the pattern for future cases.

stories.title: One seriously injured in Bexley shooting
stories.summary: One person was seriously injured in a shooting in Bexley, 10TV reported Sunday. Police have not announced an arrest.

stories.title: Woman found dead on Near East Side in apparent homicide
stories.summary: Columbus police are investigating the death of a woman found on the Near East Side as an apparent homicide. No suspect information has been released.
